summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Fullstack Developer with experience building and maintaining web and mobile applications. Specialized in Laravel and React, with additional knowledge of Vue.js 2, relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, plus Node.js and .NET. I have contributed to both frontend and backend work across diverse projects.

details.description: Built an application to manage income, expenses, customers, contracts, and payroll, plus a dashboard that optimized the purchasing of materials, tools, and office supplies. Technologies: Laravel 10, React 18, ChartJS, and automated tests with Cypress.
Created a website and administrative panel for a construction company with Laravel 11 and React 18.
Developed an application to manage employees and generate internal reports and documents, considerably reducing search and report generation time, built with Laravel 11 and React 19.

Maintained and improved a website and application used to coordinate events between sellers and buyers, including participant registration and automated notifications. Stack: Laravel 8, React, Tailwind, and Inertia.

Implemented a tool to manage sales processes visualized on a board, with integrated chat for participant communication. Used React, Redux, GO.js, and Azure Chat; also created a proxy with NodeJS and Express to connect external services. Configured and deployed the project on Azure.

Enhanced the frontend of a document management application, including document creation, editing, review, and change navigation. Technologies: Vue.js 2, GraphQL, TypeScript, Nuxt, Apollo, Storybook, and Cypress.
Built features for an online learning platform with React, Next, and Redux Saga.
Laid out and integrated views for mobile applications with React Native and Styled Components.
Maintained websites in October CMS versions 2 and 3, adding pages, search, navigation features, and CSS styling.
Created an October CMS plugin for newsletter management.

Built an application to manage civil works progress and documentation, including plan creation and photo organization, reducing the workload and documentation generation by approximately 90%, created with Laravel 6, Vue.js 2, and Vuetify.
Developed an Android application to record work progress and photographic evidence integrated with documentation generation, significantly reducing data collection time, with React Native.
Provided support and improvements for several projects for a company dedicated to school materials, built with Laravel 5.3 and 5.4, JQuery, Dio, and React, deployed on Elastic Beanstalk instances.
Implemented new features and adjustments across multiple web applications, mainly with Laravel plus other frameworks and languages.
Integrated object recognition in images and videos with AWS Rekognition, together with translation through AWS Translate and the AWS SDK for PHP, avoiding the need for manual processing.
Created a chatbot to practice multiplication tables with Botpress, along with additional bots using NodeJS and Dialogflow.
Designed, styled, and updated websites with WordPress, CSS, and Bootstrap for medium and large companies.

Built a web application for a training company focused on managing customers, trainers, courses, payments, and reports. Technologies: Laravel 5.5, Vue.js 2, Vuetify, Snappy PDF, and Maatwebsite Excel.
Implemented search tools, email modules, and other features for web applications built with .NET, C#, and JQuery.
Optimized queries in SQL Server, improving database and application performance.
Created billing modules and other features in a desktop application for a store with multiple branches, in addition to deploying it to production.
Provided client support and resolved application issues.

Built an application to manage company information: employees, payroll, construction projects, purchases, and more, improving operational efficiency, especially in project management processes, built with Laravel 5.2 and Vue.js 2.
Created an application to estimate construction costs and generate the corresponding documentation, reducing time and effort by approximately 80%, built with Laravel 5.2 and Vue.js 2.

Implemented an Android application to collect field data, capture photos with geolocation, synchronize information with the server, manage payments, and notify purchase authorizations, improving data organization and eliminating the manual data collection process, created with Java and Android Studio.
Developed the corporate website using PHP and Sass. Implemented SEO, achieving a significant increase in organic traffic and online visibility.
Modified a CodeIgniter web application used to print construction plans based on saved measurements.
